description: This file defines the DesktopManager class, which extends ApplicationService and implements DesktopManagerInterface and DesktopClientRequiresWebMethods. It manages desktop application events, component synchronization, observers, backup procedures, and communicates with web application components.

classes.name: DesktopManager
classes.description: A class that manages desktop application behavior, including event handling, component synchronization, observer registration, backup operations, and communication with the web application.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the DesktopManager with application interface and device interface.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources and observers when the instance is de-initialized.

methods.name: onAppEvent
methods.description: Handles application events such as data loading and data changes.

methods.name: saveBackup
methods.description: Triggers device to handle major data change for backup purposes.

methods.name: getExtServerHost
methods.description: Returns the extension server host URL, asserting its existence.

methods.name: convertComponentForTransmission
methods.description: Prepares a component's payload for transmission, avoiding encryption for performance.

methods.name: syncComponentsInstallation
methods.description: Synchronizes component installation by converting components and sending payloads to the device.

methods.name: registerUpdateObserver
methods.description: Registers a callback to observe component updates and returns a function to unregister.

methods.name: searchText
methods.description: Performs a text search within components via the device.

methods.name: redoSearch
methods.description: Repeats the last search if available.

methods.name: updateAvailable
methods.description: Notifies the web application of a new update.

methods.name: windowGainedFocus
methods.description: Notifies the web application when the window gains focus.

methods.name: windowLostFocus
methods.description: Notifies the web application when the window loses focus.

methods.name: onComponentInstallationComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of component installation, updating the item and notifying observers.

methods.name: requestBackupFile
methods.description: Creates a backup file, encrypted if needed, and returns its JSON string.

methods.name: didBeginBackup
methods.description: Notifies that backup download has started.

methods.name: didFinishBackup
methods.description: Notifies that backup download has finished, with success status.
